standard: course-sentence-translation 技能 R1–R4；键取自对齐原串

entries.en: More and more people think that life is better in the city than the countryside.
entries.zh: 越来越多的人认为城市生活比乡村生活更好。

entries.en: For the first time in history more than 50% of the world’s population lives in urban areas.
entries.zh: 有史以来第一次，世界人口中有超过 50% 住在城市地区。

entries.en: However, there are still many groups of people who live in some of the wildest places on the planet.
entries.zh: 不过，仍有许多群体生活在地球上最荒凉的一些地方。

entries.en: The Kalahari is a large area of bush land in southern Africa.
entries.zh: 卡拉哈里是非洲南部一片广阔的低灌木丛地带。

entries.en: It has two parts.
entries.zh: 它分为两部分。

entries.en: The south part is drier than the north and plants do not grow there very well.
entries.zh: 南部比北部更干燥，那里的植物长得不太好。

entries.en: Every year at the end of summer it rains and the land becomes more beautiful than at other times of the year.
entries.zh: 每年夏末下过雨后，这片土地会变得比一年中其他时候都更美丽。

entries.en: But the grass and the bushes soon get dry and turn brown again.
entries.zh: 但草和灌木很快又变干，重新变成褐色。

entries.en: Life there is difficult.
entries.zh: 那里的生活很艰难。

entries.en: The San are a group of people who live in the Kalahari.
entries.zh: 桑人是生活在卡拉哈里的一个族群。

entries.en: They live in huts, eat wild animals – even lions – plants and berries.
entries.zh: 他们住在小屋里，吃野生动物——甚至狮子——以及植物和浆果。

entries.en: They are very good with bows and arrows, and use them for hunting.
entries.zh: 他们非常擅长使用弓箭，并用弓箭打猎。

entries.en: Up in the mountains of central Papua New Guinea is the Chimbu Province.
entries.zh: 钦布省位于新几内亚岛中部的高山之中。

entries.en: This jungle area is one of the world’s most remote places.
entries.zh: 这片丛林地区是世界上最偏远的地方之一。

entries.en: It is also home to Mt Wilhelm, the highest mountain on the island.
entries.zh: 这里也是威廉山的所在地，那是岛上最高的山。

entries.en: Several different tribes live in the valleys between the mountains.
entries.zh: 几个不同的部族生活在山间的峡谷里。

entries.en: One of these is the Chimbu skeleton dancers.
entries.zh: 其中一个是钦布骷髅舞者部族。

entries.en: They paint skeletons onto their bodies.
entries.zh: 他们把骷髅图案画在身上。

entries.en: This makes them look scarier and it frightens other people away from their land.
entries.zh: 这让他们看起来更吓人，并把其他人吓离他们的土地。

entries.en: The Yamal Peninsula in northern Siberia is one and a half times bigger than France.
entries.zh: 西伯利亚北部的亚马尔半岛比法国大一半。

entries.en: It is frozen for much of the year and temperatures can reach -50°C in the winter.
entries.zh: 这里一年中大部分时间都冰封着，冬天温度可达 -50°C。

entries.en: But this area is home to a tribe of about 10,000 people called the Nenets.
entries.zh: 但这里生活着一个约有 10,000 人的部族，叫涅涅茨人。

entries.en: The Nenets are nomadic, meaning they frequently move from one place to another.
entries.zh: 涅涅茨人是游牧民族，也就是说他们经常从一个地方搬到另一个地方。

entries.en: Each year around 300,000 reindeer move around the land and the Nenets always go with them.
entries.zh: 每年约有 300,000 只驯鹿在这片土地上迁徙，涅涅茨人总是跟着它们走。

entries.en: The recent discovery of gas in the area means more people than before are visiting the Yamal.
entries.zh: 最近在这一地区发现天然气，意味着来亚马尔的人比以前更多了。

entries.en: So the Nenets now have more contact with the outside world.
entries.zh: 所以涅涅茨人现在与外界的接触更多了。

entries.en: The Bayan-Ölgii Province is the highest part of Mongolia.
entries.zh: 巴彦乌列盖省是蒙古海拔最高的地区。

entries.en: It is a wild area with many mountains, lakes, forests and rivers.
entries.zh: 这是一片荒凉之地，有许多山脉、湖泊、森林和河流。

entries.en: It is also home to the Kazakh golden eagle hunters.
entries.zh: 这里也是哈萨克金雕猎人的家园。

entries.en: These people travel around the mountains and use eagles to hunt for foxes and other small animals.
entries.zh: 这些人翻山越岭，用雕猎捕狐狸和其他小动物。

entries.en: When boys turn 13, they can become golden eagle hunters.
entries.zh: 男孩满 13 岁时，就可以成为金雕猎人。

entries.en: However, they have to be stronger than most boys their age because they have to show that they can carry the weight of an eagle.
entries.zh: 不过，他们必须比大多数同龄男孩更强壮，因为他们要证明自己能承受一只雕的重量。

entries.en: There are about 100,000 Kazakh people, but only around 250 of them are golden eagle hunters.
entries.zh: 哈萨克人大约有 100,000 人，但其中只有约 250 人是金雕猎人。
